title: Align served WebView smoke assertions
summary: Aligned the broad Local API served-WebView smoke with current static source contracts for Network role panels, Rename copy, Queue and Launch guardrails, Diagnostics open/tail helper signatures, Telemetry operator states, Reports diagnostics actions, and app refresh fallback handling.
reason: The Phase 1 validation cleanup exposed stale assertions in the large served-static WebView smoke after active WebView modules had already moved to role-panel Network dashboards, source-button diagnostics actions, explicit telemetry states, and failure-aware app refresh flows. Dedicated WebView tests and current source already covered those behaviors, so the smoke needed to assert the current contracts instead of removed hooks or outdated copy.
behavior_before: The served-WebView Local API smoke expected removed Network tab hooks, stale Settings/Rename/Queue/Launch/Telemetry wording, one-argument Diagnostics open/tail calls, and older app refresh render snippets. The stale expectations caused the broader Local API test module to fail even though current source and focused WebView boundary tests reflected the active behavior.
behavior_after: The smoke now asserts current stable hooks and wording: Network role panels and dashboard functions, backend-owned guardrail copy, checked-row Rename apply wording, source-button Diagnostics open/tail calls, explicit NVENC idle-as-expected telemetry state, Reports diagnostics source-button opens, and Pending Publish/Telemetry app refresh fallbacks. No product behavior was changed.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_local_api -q - passed (48 tests; expected route-error traceback is emitted by a failure-handling test)
rollback_plan: Revert the assertion updates in tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_local_api.py, refresh the generated summary for that test file, and restore this change packet to planned or remove it if no longer needed.
